title: We’re bringing Adobe’s creative and productivity tools closer to your everyday Google apps.
gist: Announced at Adobe MAX, Google and Adobe are expanding their partnership: Adobe Acrobat entry points in Google Drive and Gmail, Adobe connectors in Gemini/Gemini Enterprise and AI Mode in Google Search, Adobe's CX Enterprise Coworker agent in Gemini Enterprise, Google frontier models in Adobe apps, and joint DeepMind work on a near-real-time Photoshop image model.

insights.claim: Google Drive and Gmail will surface Adobe Acrobat as a suggested app, including an 'Edit with' entry point in file previews, giving Adobe a direct pathway into Google's productivity suite.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Distribution win for Adobe Acrobat inside Google Workspace's large user base.

insights.claim: Adobe is expanding its connectors in Gemini and Gemini Enterprise with Acrobat and additional creative tools, and will bring its creative tools to AI Mode in Google Search.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Adobe hedging AI-disintermediation risk by embedding in AI assistants and search rather than competing against them.
insights.locator: Create right where you search and chat

insights.claim: Businesses will be able to use Adobe's CX Enterprise Coworker agent inside Gemini Enterprise to design graphics, work with PDFs and launch marketing campaigns without switching apps.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Third-party agents inside Gemini Enterprise strengthen Google's enterprise agent platform ecosystem.

insights.claim: The partnership will bring Google's frontier AI models into Adobe's apps.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Adobe is a model consumer of Google, not just a builder of its own Firefly-style models — a revenue channel for Google's models.
insights.quote: It will also bring Google’s frontier AI models into Adobe’s apps.

insights.claim: Adobe and Google DeepMind will explore new editing capabilities for creative professionals, starting with an image model for Photoshop that could enable near-real-time edits.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Early-stage collaboration; signals Adobe's flagship app may lean on DeepMind image models.
